method: Maintainer semantic review plus explicit count/fragment checks; not blind and not a fresh 22-case comparison.

checks.complaint_role: Keeps unspecified product, customer role and possibility of request review.
checks.word_count: 40 whitespace tokens; keeps registered request, two needed inputs, same conversation and unknown response time.
checks.unknown_result: Preserves not received and unknown announcement time, without inferring non-occurrence.
checks.unknown_product: Keeps unspecified object, color dissatisfaction and possibility of exchange request.

limitations: Stylistic preferences were not rescored for the complete corpus after the patch.
